note: Nine requests the prompt was never tuned on, written with their expectations before any run that uses them. They are sent in file order, which mixes the kinds so that one timeout cannot remove a kind. A case with repeat: true is sent a second time with a new operation id. catalog names the agents offered: "bundled" is the bundled crew, any other name adds that list from `agents` to it. A library agent is sent as Studio sends one, without a description: the descriptions here are for the person who rates. In a proposal, a seat's agent is written by its name and resolved against the catalog when the case is sent. expect: reply "plan" means a question is a miss, "plan_or_question" accepts the named question; changes true needs a seat that changes files and false forbids one; submitters are the agents allowed to produce the last step; oneResult means the last step is a single seat; loop is "warranted", "allowed" or "none"; judges are the agents allowed to judge the loop; rounds is the loop's cap, counting an absent value as 2; uses must each hold a seat; keeps and drops are agents of the sent proposal that must stay or go; outrider lists the accepted values, "none" for absent. The machine-read flags are a first pass: every answer is also read by a person, with the case's rater line.

messages: Write the postmortem for last night's checkout outage from the timeline I'll paste, have a second person critique the draft, and revise it once if the critic requests changes.
cases.rater: A Writer judged by a reviewing agent, capped at two rounds: the first draft is round one and a pass ends the loop.

messages: Compare three vector databases for our search feature and write a recommendation
Drop the review step, I'll read it myself. Keep the rest as it is.

proposal.name: Vector database recommendation
proposal.brief: Compare three vector databases for our search feature and write a recommendation.
criteria: Three databases are compared on the same points.
The recommendation names one database and says why.

seats.name: Database researcher
seats.duty: Gather sourced facts on three vector databases for a search feature.

seats.name: Recommendation writer
seats.duty: Write the comparison and the recommendation from the researcher's facts.

seats.name: Recommendation reviewer
seats.duty: Check the draft against the researcher's facts and pass it or send it back.

cases.rater: Researcher then Writer stay, with the common comparison points and the reasoned recommendation. The review duty, the loop and any gate are gone. Seat ids and rewording do not matter.

messages: Add rate limiting to the public API. It must not be submitted unless a security review passes.
cases.rater: Passing is stated as a condition, so the plan carries the required review gate. A judged loop alone forwards its last candidate at the cap and does not meet the request.
